purpose: Independent practice of C2.2 (find missing number in addition).
student_learning_goal: I can find the missing number in an addition equation.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can find the missing number in an addition equation.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dee in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Find the missing number in each addition equation. Numbers up to 50.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Six equation rows.

image_placeholders.description: Six equation rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Pre-printed equations: 6 + ☐ = 14, ? + 7 = 15, 12 + ☐ = 25, 30 + ☐ = 45, ? + 8 = 22, 18 + ☐ = 50. Header 'Addition to 50:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_ADD50: keywords (addition, missing) name what the rows ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Find the missing number. Numbers up to 100.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Six equation rows with larger numbers.

image_placeholders.description: Six equation rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Pre-printed equations: 35 + ☐ = 60, ? + 25 = 75, 50 + ☐ = 85, 40 + ☐ = 100, ? + 30 = 90, 65 + ☐ = 95. Header 'Addition to 100:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_ADD100: keywords (addition, 100) name what the rows ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Write your own missing-addend case. Then solve it.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. A blank case box with equation and answer slots.

image_placeholders.description: A blank case-and-equation box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Top: case description lines. Middle: 'Equation: ___ + ___ = ___'. Bottom: 'Answer: ___'. Header 'My Case:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P3_OWN: keywords (case) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Case must be a missing-addend equation with a verified solution.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and solve their case.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 worksheet practices C2.2 addition. Watch for guess-and-go strategy. Encourage children to CHECK by adding.
